header.title: Cookie Policy
header.intro: This Cookie Policy explains how NovaLikes uses cookies and similar technologies when you visit and use our website.

blocks.text: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. Similar technologies can include local storage, session storage, and comparable browser storage used to remember information needed for the site to work.
NovaLikes uses cookies and similar technologies only for purposes that match current website functionality.
Strictly Necessary Cookies
Strictly necessary cookies and similar technologies support core website operation.

items: Cart: Maintains selected packages and cart contents while you shop and move between shopping and checkout hosts. Uses the first-party cookie iv_cart_v1 (up to 7 days) and a browser sessionStorage cart cache.
Checkout: Supports checkout continuity so an order can be completed after package selection and configuration.
Session: Supports browsing continuity for cart and related commerce flows. Customer accounts are not required to place an order.

Security: Supports security-related website operation, including staff administrative session protection where applicable. Staff admin access may use an iv_admin_session cookie. This is not a customer login cookie.

blocks.text: Named first-party technologies currently used

items: iv_cart_v1 — first-party cart cookie used for cart handoff (up to 7 days), together with a sessionStorage cart cache
iv_admin_session — staff administrative session cookie for NovaLikes admin access (not a customer account cookie)
novalikes.analytics.consent.v1 — browser localStorage key used to store analytics consent preferences for possible future analytics scripts

blocks.text: Functional Cookies
Beyond the essential cart, checkout, session, and security purposes listed above, NovaLikes does not currently maintain a separate inventory of optional functional preference cookies.
Analytics Cookies

No named analytics cookies or analytics providers are currently enabled in NovaLikes configuration. Optional analytics adapters (such as environment-gated integrations) are not treated as active until they are enabled in deployment with the required identifiers.
Advertising / Marketing Cookies
No advertising, remarketing, or marketing pixels are currently enabled in NovaLikes configuration.

When you complete Card Payment checkout, you may be redirected to a third-party payment collector. That payment environment may set its own cookies according to the payment provider’s practices. NovaLikes does not control those third-party cookies.
No third-party analytics or advertising cookies are currently enabled by NovaLikes configuration.
Session technologies generally last only for the browsing session or until the storage is cleared. Persistent cookies can remain for a defined period.

The cart cookie iv_cart_v1 is configured with a maximum age of up to 7 days. Exact lifetimes for other technologies can vary by browser settings and operational needs. NovaLikes does not invent additional exact durations beyond what is verified in the application.
You can control cookies through your browser settings, including blocking or deleting cookies.
NovaLikes does not currently provide a public cookie-consent banner or preference-center interface. Browser controls remain available for managing cookies.
Disabling necessary cookies or related storage may affect site functionality, including cart continuity and checkout handoff between shopping and payment flows.
NovaLikes may update this Cookie Policy when cookie practices change. The Last Updated date at the top of this page will reflect material revisions.
Questions about this Cookie Policy can be sent through the [Contact](/contact) page.
You may also email support@novalikes.com.
See also the [Privacy Policy](/privacy-policy).
